description: Match an organisation to open Raise Lens grants and tenders, from its website address or from a short profile (sectors, country, organisation type, stage). With a website address, Raise Lens reads the public homepage and up to three of its pages (robots.txt obeyed) and extracts the profile; a profile skips the reading. Returns the profile used, the number of strong matches and the best matches ranked by relevance, each with a one-line reason and its raiselens.com page. Website reading has a daily limit per caller; a profile has none.

profile.description: Use instead of url when the organisation is already known.

activities.description: Up to 6 short phrases for what it does ("mangrove restoration").

check_size_band.description: Funding size band, as the Raise Lens matching questions use it (xs, small, medium-small, medium, medium-large, large, xl, mega).

country.description: Where it works: ISO-2 ("KE"), English name ("Kenya") or "global".

sectors.description: Raise Lens sector slugs or plain words ("solar", "water"); up to 4.

stage.description: Stage: starting-out (idea, research or pilot), part-funded (some grants or investment raised) or revenue-generating. Older values (seed, series-a and so on) are still accepted.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what it does.

url.description: The organisation's website (example.org), its name without the domain ending, or its LinkedIn company page.

name: match_organisation

exact.description: false when the count is a lower bound.

profile.description: The profile the matches are ranked against.

access.description: Level of detail in this record.

apply_url.description: The application link; null where withheld.

funder.description: Funder or buyer; null where withheld.

reason.description: Why it matches, in one line.

source_url.description: The official listing; null where withheld.

status.description: ok, or why there are no matches (rate_limited, cap_reached, unreadable, ...).

summary.description: What the organisation does, as read from its website.

title: Match an organisation to funding
